name: DexDorugoramon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] If this Digimon has [Dorugoramon] in its digivolution cards, or is digivolving from the trash, delete all of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest level.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 purple or black level 3 Digimon card from your trash without paying its memory cost. If your have 5 or more cards with [Dex] or [DeathX] in their names in your trash, you may play 1 [DeathXmon] from your trash without paying its memory cost instead.
